query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.description, ua.createdAt, ua.durationMs, au.name, au.email
FROM user_actions ua
JOIN app_users au ON ua.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.name LIKE '%Linas%' OR au.email LIKE '%linas%'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
